propositions: Failed identity writes after successful issue creation currently delete the newly-created Jira issue, destroying recoverable work.
A keyed-pending binding persists after delete_issue, pointing at a deleted key, causing recover_pending to permanently fail and strand the local ticket in a retry loop.
The current rollback is redundant with rebar's own keyed-pending recovery path (recover_pending's KEYED branch), which retro-attaches labels and properties deterministically without search.
The proposed fix requires documenting that labels must be on the project's Create and Edit screens as an explicit system requirement rather than attempting createmeta pre-flight validation.
A BindingPersistError case where record_pending_key fails leaves an unmarked issue in the project, which is safer than deletion since the inbound pass will adopt it as a new remote issue.
